title: Arithmetic level raising, diagonal reciprocity and Rankin–Selberg Selmer ranks
summary: Extend the Selmer library by native unitary arithmetic level raising, diagonal Abel–Jacobi classes and two explicit reciprocity laws, ending in rank zero from an explicit definite period and rank one from a nonzero regulator, with the uniform CM Frobenius span premise and all supplier obligations explicit. All exceptional sets are finite. Auxiliary CM-model cohomology uses PELModuli H_𝔗/H_𝔗,c and orbit trace. Positive-loss detection uses scaled inverses and primitive kernels; the rank-one contradiction has total detection loss 2c.

layers.title: Coefficient algebra, local predicates and admissibility

targets.name: specialInertPlace
targets.statement: For a CM extension F/F⁺ and a finite place v of F⁺, define special inertness by inertness in F, an odd underlying rational prime p unramified in F, and F⁺ᵥ≃ℚp. Define very special inertness by also requiring v to split completely in F⁺rflx, equivalently to have a place above v with completion ℚp; Fᵣflx is the compositum of F with the intersection of the reflex fields of all CM types of F.

targets.adversarial: p=2,3, split/ramified/inert and degree two over ℚp. No residue-degree-one hypothesis is deleted on the strength of Remark 3.3.5.

targets.name: rankinSelbergAdmissible
targets.statement: For the standing relevant pair, strong field E and finite exceptional set Σ⁺min, define admissibility of λ|ℓ by the seven independent clauses L1–L7 recorded below. Choose stable lattices Rα in ρΠα,λ(rα), of ranks nα, with (1−α)-polarizations Ξα; admissibility is invariant under their homotheties, polarization units and basis changes. L1: ℓ>4n and ℓ unramified in F. L2: no place above ℓ lies in Σ⁺min. L3: ρΠ₀,λ⊗ρΠ₁,λ is absolutely irreducible. L4: both factors are residually absolutely irreducible. L5-1: on R̄₀⊗R̄₁ either the residual image contains a scalar different from 1, or the module is semisimple, has dimension ≤min((ℓ+1)/2,ℓ−3), and HomΓF(End(R̄),R̄)=0. L5-2: over F⁺rflx the image of (ρ̄₀+,ρ̄₁+,ε̄ℓ) contains (γ₀,γ₁,ξ) with ξ²≠1, γα in the conjugate component of order prime to ℓ, eigenvalue 1 simple in hγ₀, hγ₁ and their tensor, and no eigenvalues −1 in hγ₀ or −ξ in hγ₁. Here hγ is the GL component of γ². L6: the even polarized residual representation is rigid for (Σ⁺min,∅) and stays absolutely irreducible over F(ζℓ). L7: both residual Hecke characters are cohomologically generic.
hypotheses: All exceptional and raising sets are finite; the containing sets include Σ⁺min and the raising set, whose rational support is disjoint from Σ⁺min. The auxiliary support avoids the containing set, and Σ⁺min avoids ℓ where required.

layers.title: Unitary integral models, incidence and the semistable product

targets.name: unitaryLevelRaisingDatum
targets.statement: For N≥2 put r=⌊N/2⌋. Bundle a relevant Π, strong E, a finite set Σ⁺min⊇Σ⁺Π of finite places and a finite set Σ⁺lr of inert places strongly disjoint from Σ⁺min (their underlying rational supports are disjoint), and a finite Σ⁺⊇Σ⁺min∪Σ⁺lr; λ|ℓ with no ℓ-adic place in Σ⁺min and ℓ∤Nv((Nv)²−1) for v∈Σ⁺lr; m≥1; a standard definite V° of rank N with self-dual lattice away from these sets and infinity; and neat K°, hyperspecial elsewhere, transferable at Σ⁺min and special maximal at Σ⁺lr in even rank, where V° is nonsplit. Include a special inert p, all auxiliary CM-moduli data of §§3.5/5.1 and an indefinite uniformization datum. Require P1: p-adic places avoid Σ⁺; P2: ℓ∤p(p²−1); P3: a CM type Φ containing τ∞ with Qp^Φ=ℚp²; P4: even PΠ,p is special modulo λᵐ, odd PΠ,p is Tate generic modulo λ; P5: PΠ,p is intertwining generic modulo λ; P6 in even rank: restriction of the congruence Hecke ideal away from p gives the same quotient of (OE/λᵐ)[Sh(V°,K°)] as the full ideal. Define mΠ and nΠ as contractions, to the algebra away from Σ⁺ and p, of the kernels of φΠ modulo λ and λᵐ.
hypotheses: All exceptional and raising sets are finite; the containing sets include Σ⁺min and the raising set, whose rational support is disjoint from Σ⁺min. The auxiliary support avoids the containing set, and Σ⁺min avoids ℓ where required.

targets.name: unitaryBasicCorrespondence
targets.statement: For the smooth standard-indefinite integral PEL model M at a special inert p, over the CM auxiliary base Tp, realize the source S and isogeny correspondence S←π B→ι M of §4.3. Over any field κ containing the residue field and s∈S(κ), B_s is smooth projective geometrically irreducible of dimension ⌊(N−1)/2⌋; ι is locally a closed immersion of codimension ⌊N/2⌋. Its tangent bundle is Hom(ωA∨,τ∞,ker α*,τ∞/ωA∨,τ∞) and its normal bundle is Hom(ωA∨,τ∞,im α*,τ∞). The fibre is the hermitian Frobenius incidence variety DL(V_s,{,}_s,⌈(N+1)/2⌉).

targets.name: unitarySemistableStrata
targets.statement: For the definite datum and CM-moduli data of §5.1, take the native strictly semistable M, its reduced smooth components M°, M• and link M†=M°∩M• from gap native-shimura. Identify their source-specific incidence presentations and normal bundles as follows. The balloon correspondence B°→M° is an isomorphism, with fibres ℙ(V_s) over points of S° in perfect residue fields; the link in a balloon fibre is the degree-(p+1) hermitian Fermat hypersurface. The link normal in the balloon component is O(p+1); its normal in the ground component is the dual O(−(p+1)). Over perfect residue fields κ, ground fibres B•_s are the projective smooth incidence varieties DL•(V_s,{,}_s), of dimension ⌊N/2⌋. Retain the tangent and normal maps from the universal isogenies, and the link fibre projective bundles of §5.5.

targets.name: unitaryLinkAndIntersection
targets.statement: For the strata of 2.3 and p-coprime coefficient L, balloon and link cohomology are free L-modules. If p+1 is a unit, restriction Hⁱ_𝔗(M°)→Hⁱ_𝔗(M†) is an isomorphism except in degrees N−2 and 2N−2. In even rank, Frobenius on Hᴺ⁻²_𝔗(M†,L((N−2)/2)) is trivial. For two ground fibres over a perfect κ, their fibre product decomposes by relative positions 0≤j≤⌊N/2⌋−1 into DL• incidence varieties. The corresponding link indexing set has ∏_{i=1}^{⌊N/2⌋−j}(p^(2i−1)+1) points, and each link intersection fibre is ℙ of a vector space of dimension ⌊N/2⌋−j. The excess bundle on it is σ*H⊗O(1), with H the tautological subbundle.

Define ∇₁ on E₂⁰,²ʳ and ∇₀ on ker d₁⁰,²ʳ by the linear combinations in Construction 5.9.4, preserving T°•,T•° and the factors (p+1)² and p+1.

targets.name: unitaryProductResolution
targets.statement: For compatible rank-n and rank-(n+1) semistable data, form P=M_n×Tp M_n+1 and Q=Bl_{P°°}P, with its strict transforms and the strict transform QΔ of the diagonal graph. Q is strictly semistable of relative dimension 2n−1, with four component strata and a weight sequence in columns −2,…,2. On mixed component pairs σ is an isomorphism; on the two equal component pairs it is the blowup of P††, and Q††→P†† is a trivial ℙ¹-bundle. For each equal component pair, Hⁱ_𝔗(Q?₀,?₁,Oλ) is the sum of σ*Hⁱ_𝔗(P?₀,?₁,Oλ) and the exceptional Hⁱ⁻²_𝔗(P††,Oλ(−1)); specialization to nearby cycles is an isomorphism for both ordinary and compact supports.

layers.title: Odd Tate cycles and even integral arithmetic level raising

targets.name: localizedUnitaryCohomology
targets.statement: For 2.1, residual absolute irreducibility identifies compactly supported and ordinary localized cohomology of the indefinite generic fibre and the ground stratum, in every degree. Under intertwining genericity the two special-maximal-level intertwiners on definite functions localized at mΠ are isomorphisms. Under cohomological genericity, localized nearby cohomology is concentrated in degree N−1 and free there; this latter conclusion uses the derived integral reduction comparison.

tests.name: intertwiner_localization_required
tests.statement: Without localization, an automorphic π with (π_p)^{K•}≠0=(π_p)^{K°} contributes only to the target of T•°; that map then fails to be surjective. The bad local Satake pairs are {−1,−1} in even rank and {−p,−p⁻¹} in odd rank. P5 for Π excludes them only on the Π-congruent support after localization, not on every automorphic constituent (ltxzz lines 5230–5245).

targets.proofSketch: Residual irreducibility excludes boundary isobaric constituents; the local intertwining factors are units by SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups §SR.4.4. After localization at mΠ, the rank comparison runs only over Π-congruent standard pairs; P5 excludes the bad Satake pairs on this support (ltxzz lines 5230–5245). The universal coefficient sequence and Nakayama convert residual concentration to integral concentration and freeness.
targets.adversarial: Zero localization allowed here; nonproper boundary requires its own theorem; residual irreducibility is in scope.

targets.name: oddTateCycleComparison
targets.statement: For 2.1 with N=2r+1, ∇₁:E₂⁰,²ʳ_mΠ→Oλ[Sh(V°,K°)]_mΠ is surjective. Under A6.1.4 alone (integral nearby cohomology concentrated in degree N−1 and free there), E₂ is supported only at (0,2r) and is free there.
